incidents.description: Default Kaggle GPU allocation selected Tesla P100 (Pascal, sm_60). PyTorch 2.10.0+cu128 in Kaggle Python 3.12 container dropped support for sm_60 (requires sm_70+).
incidents.scientific_impact: NONE. Caught prior to training execution.
incidents.resolution: Explicitly specified 'machine_shape': 'NvidiaTeslaT4' in kernel metadata and '--accelerator NvidiaTeslaT4' in Kaggle CLI push, provisioning Turing sm_75 dual T4 GPUs.

incidents.description: Manifest sample paths generated on Windows contained backslashes ('\'). On Linux POSIX, Path.name does not interpret backslashes as path separators, causing initial pre-training file hash check to report missing files.
incidents.scientific_impact: NONE. Pre-flight assertion halted script before training.
incidents.resolution: Implemented robust cross-platform path normalization using os.path.basename(path.replace('\\', '/')) and an O(1) global file dictionary index over /kaggle/input.

incidents.description: Initial standalone decoder upsampling stage in train_replicate003.py yielded 14,337,516 parameters (+26,656 over frozen protocol). Hard parameter guardrail asserted trainable_params == 14,310,860 and halted run before training.
incidents.scientific_impact: NONE. Zero epochs trained on mismatched architecture. Exact guardrail operated as designed.
incidents.resolution: Imported and integrated canonical ResNet18UNet implementation from src/ocean_sentinel/ml/exp07_reference.py, verified locally and remotely to have exactly 14,310,860 trainable parameters and 30 BatchNorm2d layers.

incidents.description: CandidateFWeightedSampler called super().__init__(None), which failed under PyTorch 2.10 / Python 3.12 where Sampler inherits from object directly, taking zero arguments.
incidents.scientific_impact: NONE. Failed at constructor initialization prior to batch loading or training.
incidents.resolution: Updated constructor to call super().__init__() without arguments.

incidents.description: Antigravity IDE encountered a transient DNS/HTTP connection drop while polling remote service, triggering an emergency continuation prompt.
incidents.scientific_impact: NONE. Strict adherence to No-Duplicate-Run rule: Remote state was queried first, verified, and preserved without duplicate job launches.
incidents.resolution: Executed remote status query, retrieved logs, confirmed execution identity, and monitored remote run to completion.
